title: Automations
description: A scheduler outside the agent loop enqueues due work. cron starts a fresh turn into the inbox; heartbeat resumes the same thread.

steps.content: Every weekday morning, review open tasks. Also keep watching this thread for anything new.
steps.annotation: The user wants unattended work: a standalone recurring run, and a same-thread check-in.
cron automations are stored outside the loop (App: automation.toml + RRULE).
heartbeat automations target an existing thread instead of opening a new one.
The scheduler only enqueues. It never runs the agent.
Dispatcher dequeues the cron job and starts a fresh turn, like codex exec.
The cron turn's findings are written to the inbox / Triage, then the turn ends.

steps.content: inbox ← cron repo-check · heartbeatThread ← [Heartbeat] anything new?
steps.annotation: A later tick resumes the same heartbeat thread instead of starting from zero.
